description_en: Queries the usage statistics of Intelligent Media Services (IMS) on video-on-demand (VOD) editing. The maximum query range is 31 days. You can query data within the last 90 days
description_zh: IMS点播视频剪辑用量查询，最大查询范围31天，最远可查90天内的数据
name: DescribeMeterImsEditUsage

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a 10-digit timestamp
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a 10-digit timestamp
parameters.name: end_ts

parameters.help_en: The time granularity of the query. Valid values: 3600 (hour) and 86400 (day)
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间粒度，枚举值：3600（小时粒度），86400（天粒度）
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: This parameter does not take effect. By default, the usage data of all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh: 目前该字段暂未生效，默认返回全部region用量
parameters.name: region
